findings.title: Death toll in the Gaza Strip rises to 74,609, with 175,872 injured since the start of the aggression
findings.publication_time_local: 12:11 PM (WAFA site display; timezone not specified)
findings.reporting_period: Hospitals received cases during the preceding 48 hours; specific endpoint and incident timestamps not supplied.
findings.location: Gaza Strip; individual hospitals and incident locations not specified in the aggregate
findings.affected_population_system: Gaza hospital and rescue services. A medical-source tally reports 15 fatalities and 38 injured received by hospitals over 48 hours; 18 previously slain people were separately added to the cumulative toll following identity-record verification. It also states ambulances and rescuers cannot reach some casualties under rubble or on roads.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: hospitals in the Gaza Strip have received 15 fatalities and 38 injured individuals over the past 48 hours.
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian news agency relaying medical-source casualty bulletin
findings.confidence: medium-high (direct source article verified; cumulative and window counts attributed to unnamed Gaza medical sources, not independently audited)

bounded_discovery_context.source_detail: WAFA reports 74,609 cumulative fatalities and 175,872 cumulative injured since October 7, 2023; since October 11, 2025 ceasefire, 1,593 fatalities, 5,748 injuries, and 847 bodies recovered.
